title: Quantum optimisation in cities: Limitations and prospects of urban transport systems
summary: Recently, quantum computing has gained attention in urban studies as a tool for complex transport planning problems, but its role remains unclear. This paper reviews quantum computing research in urban transport planning and highlights major limits in scalability, robustness, constraint handling, and engineering feasibility.Stable and reproducible advantages of quantum optimisation in real urban systems have yet to be shown.
